steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each area's result is placed against its exposure limit, or noted as unmeasured.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 exposure result is above its limit

findings.title: Area with no measurement in the period

outcome.notChecked: Individual exposure; the health effect of any result.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] area-paint.csv:12  Result above the exposure limit.
       Fix: Reduce the exposure and re-measure.
[medium] area-stores.csv:19  Area with no measurement in the period.
       Fix: Measure the area this period.
[low] units.csv:26  Result with no unit.
       Fix: Record the unit.
Not checked: Individual exposure; the health effect of any result.
pros: Checks a result above its limit, a result with no limit, an area with no measurement in the period, and a missing unit.
cons: Not checked: Individual exposure; the health effect of any result.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-exposure-monitoring skill on the records for this review.
